title: PROJECTIVE PSYCHOLOGICAL ASSESSMENT OF LARGE MULTIMODAL MODELS USING THEMATIC APPERCEPTION TESTS
reasoning: The study benchmarks Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) using the SCORS-G scale, which explicitly includes 'Emotional Investment in Moral Standards (EIM)' as one of its eight core dimensions to assess a model's commitment to personal and societal values. It also analyzes the models' performance regarding moral conflict and struggle.
